related_questions.question: What should I do if I test positive?

text_blocks.snippet: If you test positive for COVID-19, the first step is to contact your healthcare provider to discuss your situation and any potential treatments. You should also take care of yourself at home by resting, staying hydrated, and managing symptoms with over-the-counter medications. It's crucial to monitor your symptoms and report any worsening conditions to your healthcare provider. If you experience severe symptoms like difficulty breathing or chest pain, seek immediate medical attention by calling 911 and informing them of your COVID-19 status.
snippet_highlighted_words: contact your healthcare provider to discuss your situation and any potential treatments

list.title: 1. Contact your healthcare provider:
list.snippet: Inform them of your positive test result and discuss any underlying health conditions or symptoms you're experiencing. They may recommend specific treatments or additional monitoring.

list.title: 2. Take care of yourself at home:
list.snippet: Rest and stay hydrated to help your body recover.

list.title: 3. Manage symptoms:
list.snippet: Over-the-counter medications can help alleviate symptoms like fever, cough, and body aches.

list.title: 4. Monitor your symptoms:
list.snippet: Watch for any changes or worsening symptoms, and report them to your healthcare provider.

list.title: 5. Seek immediate medical attention for severe symptoms:
list.snippet: If you experience severe symptoms such as difficulty breathing, persistent chest pain, or new confusion, call 911 and notify the responder that you have COVID-19.

list.title: 6. Protect others:
list.snippet: If you live with others, try to isolate yourself from them and take precautions to prevent further spread of the virus, according to government guidelines said the Australian Government Department of Health.
